title: Optimization Request (Wasm / JSON)
description: A unified request payload encapsulating problem data and solver configuration parameters.

capacities.description: Capacity limits for each resource dimension.

items.description: List of candidate items available for selection.

rules.description: Logical business constraints governing item selections.

target_value.description: Optional target objective value to satisfy.

BusinessRule.title: Business Rule
BusinessRule.description: Logical constraints specifying dependencies or mutual exclusions between items.

to_id.description: The item that must be included as a prerequisite.

oneOf.title: Conflict Constraint
oneOf.description: Items `a_id` and `b_id` are mutually exclusive and cannot be selected together.

Item.title: Selectable Item
Item.description: Represents a decision candidate with multi-dimensional resource consumption and an associated objective value.

id.description: Unique identifier of the item (zero-based index).

name.description: Display name or human-readable label of the item.

value.description: Value, profit, or score gained if this item is selected.

weights.description: Consumption weights for each corresponding capacity dimension.

OptimizerConfig.title: Optimizer Configuration
OptimizerConfig.description: Parameters governing solver behavior, constraints, and search strategy.

max_nodes.description: The maximum number of search nodes to explore.

strategy.description: The search strategy (e.g., Pure, Info, Mixed).

time_limit_ms.description: The execution time limit in milliseconds.

top_k.description: The number of top candidate solutions to retain.

SolverStrategy.title: Solver Optimization Strategy
SolverStrategy.description: Execution mode controlling the search and optimization algorithm.

oneOf.description: Automatically selects the faster strategy (`Pure` vs. `Heuristic`) based on problem size and constraint density (default).
Exact branch-and-bound search without graph-based structural heuristics.
Branch-and-bound search guided by structural heuristics, leveraging constraint graph embeddings and a greedy strategy for an initial warm start.
